_comment: Kaabil career knowledge base. Every fact the Career tab shows comes from here, never from the LLM. Fields: routes[].from = minimum completed qualification (class_8, class_10, class_12, class_12_science, class_12_pcb, class_12_pcm_or_pcb, class_12_commerce, graduate, any); where = local | district | city | online | distance. pay.basis: official (from a recruitment notification / pay matrix) or estimate. sources[].checked says how a fact was checked; 'secondary' = several secondary sources agree, confirm in the current official notification before relying on it. learn_source='official' marks modules extracted from a government curriculum PDF by career/ingest.py.

careers.summary: Install and repair house wiring, motors, pumps and panels. Works in villages and towns; can open an own shop.

routes.label: ITI Electrician (2 years) after Class 10

cost.note: government ITI is low-cost; private ITI costs more

steps: Pass Class 10
Apply to a government ITI in your district (state ITI admission, usually May–July)
Finish 2 years and pass the trade test for the National Trade Certificate (NTC)
Do a 1-year apprenticeship under the National Apprenticeship scheme (stipend paid)
Get a wiring licence from the state electricity authority to work on your own

pay.note: apprenticeship stipend is set by the government; own shop income varies

skills_now: Learn safe use of a multimeter
Help a local electrician on weekends

careers.summary: Install and maintain rooftop and farm solar panels and solar pumps, a fast-growing job in villages under government solar schemes.

routes.label: Short skill course (Skill India / NSQF) after Class 10
steps: Find a 'Solar PV Installer' training centre on Skill India Digital Hub
Finish the course and pass the assessment for an NSQF certificate
Work with a solar installer or company for a year
Register as an installer with your state's renewable energy agency for rooftop scheme work

routes.label: ITI Electrician first, then solar
steps: Do ITI Electrician
Add the solar installer course
Work on rooftop and solar pump projects

learn: Solar panel types and how they make electricity
Safety at height and with DC power
skills_now: Watch how a solar pump in your village is set up

careers.summary: Repair phones and small electronics; one of the easiest trades to start as a shop in a village or market.

routes.label: Short skill course (Skill India / NSQF)
steps: Join a 'Field Technician – Mobile Phone / Handset Repair' course on Skill India Digital Hub
Practise on old phones; buy a basic toolkit
Work 6–12 months in a repair shop
Open your own counter; a MUDRA loan can fund tools

routes.label: ITI Electronics Mechanic (2 years)
steps: Pass Class 10
Join ITI Electronics Mechanic
Specialise in phone and laptop repair

learn: Phone parts and how they work
Changing screens, batteries and charging ports
Running a small shop: stock and accounts

pay.note: own shop income depends on the market

skills_now: Keep fixing phones for neighbours, note each fault and fix

careers.summary: Type and manage records on computers in offices, banks, hospitals and government services; a first step into IT work.

routes.label: Domestic Data Entry Operator course (NSQF level 3)
steps: Join a Data Entry Operator course (NASSCOM-approved) through Skill India
Practise typing to 30+ words a minute in English and Hindi/Marathi
Apply to local offices, CSC centres and BPOs
Later sit the SSC CHSL exam for government Data Entry Operator posts (needs Class 12)

routes.label: ITI COPA (Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, 1 year)
steps: Pass Class 10
Join ITI COPA
Apprenticeship or office job

learn: MS Word, Excel and data entry tools
Email and internet use at work

free_learning.name: Spoken Tutorial (IIT Bombay) — free computer courses in Hindi/Marathi

sources.name: NQR Qualification File: Domestic Data Entry Operator (NSQF 3)

careers.summary: Turn numbers into answers for businesses using Excel, SQL and charts. Much of the learning is available free online.

routes.label: Any degree (B.Com, B.Sc, BCA, B.A. Economics) + data skills

cost.note: government college or distance degree keeps it low; skills can be learnt free online

steps: Join a degree you can manage near home or by distance (B.Com, BCA, B.Sc or B.A. Economics)
From year 1, learn Excel, then SQL and a chart tool, using free courses
Build 3 small projects on real data (e.g. your village's crop prices)
Apply for internships in the final year; first job is often 'MIS executive' or 'junior analyst'

learn: Charts and dashboards (Power BI / Looker Studio)

pay.note: mostly in cities; some remote work

careers.summary: Build apps and websites. Needs strong logic and steady self-study; good jobs are mostly in cities or remote.

routes.label: BCA or B.Sc Computer Science (3 years)

cost.note: government colleges cost far less than private

steps: Join BCA or B.Sc CS (some colleges need Maths in Class 12)
Learn one language deeply (Python or JavaScript) with free courses
Build 3–4 projects and put them on GitHub
Apply for internships in year 3

routes.label: B.Tech / B.E. Computer Science (4 years, needs Maths)

cost.note: JEE Main / state entrance; government colleges cheaper

steps: Take Physics, Chemistry and Maths in Class 11–12
Write JEE Main and your state engineering entrance
Join the best government college you can get
Internships from year 3

routes.label: Polytechnic Diploma in Computer Engineering (3 years)
steps: After Class 10, write the state polytechnic entrance
Finish the diploma
Work, or join B.Tech year 2 by lateral entry

pay.note: wide range; depends on skills and city

skills_now: Free Python course in your language

free_learning.name: Spoken Tutorial (Python, Java) in Indian languages

careers.summary: Build systems that learn from data, like voice assistants and crop-disease detection. Needs strong maths and several years of study.

routes.label: B.Tech CSE / AI (4 years, needs Maths)

cost.note: JEE Main / state entrance; government colleges and scholarships help

steps: Take PCM in Class 11–12 and do well in Maths
Write JEE Main and state entrances
Learn Python, statistics and machine learning alongside college
Do projects and internships; many AI roles want a master's degree or strong projects

routes.label: B.Sc Maths / Statistics / CS, then AI skills
steps: B.Sc with Maths or Statistics
Free NPTEL machine-learning courses
Projects and a master's later

careers.summary: Build roads, buildings, irrigation and machines. A diploma after Class 10 leads to site jobs and government junior engineer exams.

routes.label: Polytechnic Diploma (3 years) after Class 10
steps: Write your state polytechnic entrance after Class 10
Choose Civil, Mechanical or Electrical
Work as site supervisor or junior engineer
Sit SSC JE / state JE exams, or join B.Tech year 2 by lateral entry

skills_now: Visit a construction site with a mason or contractor

careers.summary: Service bikes, tractors and farm machines; steady demand in every village and town.

routes.label: ITI Mechanic Motor Vehicle / Mechanic Tractor
steps: Join ITI Mechanic Motor Vehicle, Mechanic Diesel or Mechanic Tractor
Apprenticeship at a dealer workshop
Work at a service centre, then open your own garage

routes.label: Two-wheeler service technician (short NSQF course)
steps: Join a 'Two-Wheeler Service Technician' course via Skill India
Work at a local garage
Own garage later

skills_now: Learn the parts of a bike engine

careers.summary: Care for patients in hospitals and health centres. Respected work with jobs in villages, towns and abroad.

routes.label: B.Sc Nursing (4 years) after Class 12 Science with Biology

cost.note: government nursing colleges are much cheaper; many states use an entrance test

steps: Take Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English in Class 11–12
Write your state's B.Sc Nursing entrance (or the college's test)
Finish 4 years including hospital training
Register with the State Nursing Council
Apply to government hospitals (staff nurse exams) or private hospitals

routes.label: ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwife, 2 years)
steps: Pass Class 12 (most states accept any stream)
Join an ANM school approved by the Indian Nursing Council
Register with the State Nursing Council
Work at sub-centres and primary health centres

pay.note: government staff nurse pay is higher

sources.name: Indian Nursing Council (recognised institutions, course rules)
sources.checked: official site; GNM is being replaced by B.Sc Nursing in many states, so GNM is not offered here

careers.summary: Test blood and samples in labs. Small towns need many technicians; can later run an own collection centre.

routes.label: DMLT diploma (2 years) after Class 12 Science
steps: Pass Class 12 Science (Biology preferred)
Join a DMLT course at a recognised institute
Train in a hospital lab
Work in labs or open a collection centre after experience

routes.label: B.Sc MLT (3 years)
steps: Class 12 with PCB
B.Sc Medical Lab Technology
Lab jobs and government technician posts

skills_now: Visit a local lab to see the work

careers.summary: Dispense medicines in hospitals and chemist shops. A D.Pharm lets you open your own medical store.

routes.label: D.Pharm (2 years) after Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Maths

cost.note: admission is usually on Class 12 marks; no NEET needed

steps: Pass Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Maths
Join a college approved by the Pharmacy Council of India
Register with your State Pharmacy Council
Work in a hospital or chemist shop; open your own medical store later (drug licence)

skills_now: Spend time at a local chemist to learn the work

sources.name: Pharmacy Council of India (approved institutions)
sources.checked: secondary sources agree on eligibility (PCB or PCM); confirm with PCI

careers.summary: Help nurses with patient care in hospitals and homes. Short training, quick job, and a first step into healthcare.

routes.label: General Duty Assistant course (NSQF, Healthcare Sector Skill Council)
steps: Join a GDA course through Skill India
Hospital on-the-job training
Work in hospitals, nursing homes or home care
Later move to ANM or nursing

careers.summary: Advise farmers on crops, soil and pests; work in banks, seed companies or government agriculture departments.

routes.label: B.Sc Agriculture (4 years)

cost.note: state agriculture universities are cheaper; entrance via ICAR or state test

steps: Class 12 with Science (Biology or Maths)
Write the state agriculture entrance or ICAR AIEEA
B.Sc Agriculture with village fieldwork
Agriculture officer exams, bank agri officer, or own agri business

routes.label: Diploma in Agriculture (2–3 years, state agriculture university)
steps: After Class 10, apply to your state agriculture university's diploma
Work as agriculture assistant or start agri services

ladder: Senior agri officer / bank agri manager

pay.note: government posts pay by state pay scales

skills_now: Keep notes on your family's crops, costs and yields

careers.summary: Run a dairy, goat or poultry unit with modern practice; government schemes fund training and loans.

routes.label: Dairy / livestock training (KVK or NSQF) + government loan schemes

cost.note: Krishi Vigyan Kendra trainings are often free

steps: Take a dairy, goat or poultry training at your district Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK)
Start small with 2–3 animals and keep records of feed, milk and costs
Join the village milk cooperative for steady sales
Apply for a loan under MUDRA or PMEGP to grow

skills_now: Keep a daily notebook of your animals' feed and milk
Learn vaccination schedules from the vet

careers.summary: Keep accounts, bills and GST returns for shops and small businesses. Work exists in every town; can freelance from home.

routes.label: Accounts Executive / Tally + GST course (3–6 months)
steps: Join an 'Accounts Executive' course (BFSI Sector Skill Council) or a Tally + GST course
Practise on real bills from a local shop
Work as accounts assistant with a CA or a business
Take clients of your own; a B.Com alongside helps

routes.label: B.Com (3 years, regular or distance) + Tally/GST

cost.note: government college or distance (IGNOU/state open university)

steps: Join B.Com near home or by distance
Learn Tally and GST in year 1
Work part-time with a CA or shop

skills_now: Keep a clean ledger for a family shop

careers.summary: Serve customers in a public-sector bank. Secure job with fixed hours; needs a degree and a competitive exam.

routes.label: Any degree, then IBPS Clerk / SBI Clerk exam

cost.note: degree at government college or distance; free mock tests exist

steps: Finish any degree (B.Com suits you if you like accounts)
From year 2, practise reasoning, quantitative aptitude and English daily
Apply when IBPS publishes the Clerk notification (usually August)
Clear prelims, mains and the local-language test
Join a public-sector bank as Customer Service Associate

pay.note: IBPS Clerk 2025 notification scale; gross varies by posting

careers.earn_after: about 3–4 years (after a degree and the exam)

sources.checked: secondary sources agree on age 20–28, any degree, basic ₹24,050 (CRP Clerks-XV, 2025); confirm in the current notification

careers.summary: Audit, tax and finance expert; one of the most respected commerce careers. Long and demanding, with low pass rates.

routes.label: CA Foundation after Class 12 → Intermediate → articleship → Final

cost.note: ICAI fees are moderate; coaching is the big cost — ICAI's own study material is free online

steps: Register with ICAI for CA Foundation after Class 12
Clear Foundation, then Intermediate
Do practical training (articleship) with a CA firm, often in a town or city
Clear CA Final and become a member of ICAI

ladder: Senior manager / partner in a firm

careers.summary: Run banking, bill payment and government e-services for your village from a small counter. Earns commission; works from home village.

routes.label: Become a Common Service Centre (CSC) operator / bank correspondent

cost.note: computer, printer, internet and IIBF certificate fee

steps: Get basic computer skills
Register as a Village Level Entrepreneur on the CSC portal

ladder: Bank correspondent with a bank tie-up
skills_now: Help people in your village fill online forms

careers.summary: Serve 4 years in the Army under the Agnipath scheme; up to 25% are later made permanent. Needs physical fitness.

routes.label: Agniveer General Duty (Class 10 pass)
steps: Pass Class 10 (General Duty usually needs 45% overall and 33% per subject; check the notification)
Train daily: 1.6 km run, pull-ups, long jump
Apply on joinindianarmy.nic.in when your zone's notification opens
Online exam → physical test at the rally → medical
4 years of service; apply for permanent service or use the Seva Nidhi for a next career

routes.label: Agniveer Clerk / Technical (Class 12)
steps: Pass Class 12 (Technical needs Science with Maths)
Apply for the Clerk/Store Keeper or Technical category
Exam, physical and medical tests

pay.start: ₹30,000 a month package in year 1 (₹21,000 in hand), rising to ₹40,000 in year 4; Seva Nidhi of about ₹11.71 lakh on exit

sources.name: Join Indian Army — Agnipath
